params.1273: Successfully cast Level-1 Enchant on an item of jewellery.
params.1274: You will need level 7 Magic to cast this spell.
params.1275: You will also need a 1 water rune and 1 cosmic rune, and an item of sapphire jewellery to cast it on.
params.1276: The magic shop in Varrock sells water runes.
params.1277: Completing the Task 'Not So Confusing After All' will allow you to claim a sapphire amulet and a cosmic rune from Explorer Jack or any other taskmaster.
params.1278: Activate the spell by clicking on it in the list, then on the item you wish to enchant.
params.1279: Free players cannot enchant jewellery other than amulets.
params.2225: Enchanted jewellery has a wide range of effects including teleports, smelting assistance, damage reflection in combat and even improved luck.
